components/codeblock.tsx.name: Code block figure
components/codeblock.tsx.description: Client component rendering a Shiki code figure with title, copy button and tabbed variants; the AI chat uses it for streamed code.

components/mdx.tsx.name: MDX component registry
components/mdx.tsx.description: Maps every MDX tag to its React component and wraps resolvable internal links in the hover LinkPreview card.

components/mdx/Accordion.tsx.name: Accordion
components/mdx/Accordion.tsx.description: Keeps a closed Fumadocs accordion panel mounted with hidden=until-found, so its text is in server HTML and browser Find opens it.

components/mdx/AddressExplorerLink.tsx.name: Address explorer link
components/mdx/AddressExplorerLink.tsx.description: Links a checksummed address to its block explorer by chain id, throwing on a bad checksum or unknown chain; the AEL tag.

components/mdx/Callout.tsx.name: Callout
components/mdx/Callout.tsx.description: Renders the five callout types with a coloured left border, tint and Octicon, each as role=note so none announce as a live region.

components/mdx/FindableTab.tsx.name: Findable tab
components/mdx/FindableTab.tsx.description: Force-mounts an inactive Fumadocs Tab panel at zero height so browser Find can reveal and select it.

components/mdx/ReferenceList.tsx.name: Reference list
components/mdx/ReferenceList.tsx.description: Async server component that renders a whole reference collection as anchored sections, backing the glossary index page.

components/mdx/Term.tsx.name: Glossary term
components/mdx/Term.tsx.description: Async server component that renders a glossary entry's MDX definition into a HoverPopover; nested terms render as plain text.

components/mdx/use-findable-panel.ts.name: Findable panel hook
components/mdx/use-findable-panel.ts.description: Sets hidden=until-found on an inactive Radix panel and opens it on beforematch, so browser Find reaches hidden tab and accordion text.

components/mdx/Var/index.tsx.name: Global variable
components/mdx/Var/index.tsx.description: Server component that prints a value from content/vars.json inline; an unknown name renders undefined and fails vars:check.

components/tabs/ui.tsx.name: Tabs primitive
components/tabs/ui.tsx.description: Client tabs on Base UI with groupId sharing across instances, persisted selection and URL-hash sync; the code block tabs build on it.
